source_title: Iran Captures 2nd US Military Aircraft Intact Using Electronic Warfare; Big Blow To Trump
source_excerpt: Iran has claimed the capture of yet another American MQM-170 drone near Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz, marking the second such claim by the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) within 48 hours. Tehran says its forces used electronic warfare systems to take control of the unmanned aircraft and recover it intact. The latest claim follows an earlier announcement by the IRGC Navy that it had seized another US MQM-170 drone over the western Strait of Hormuz. Iranian media said the drones were deployed to identify Iranian air defence positions along the Gulf coast. Washington, however, has rejected the earlier Iranian account.
